products.name: Linear Diaphragm Actuator
products.description: Airalinear diaphragm actuator is a pneumatic or hydraulic actuator that converts fluid pressure into linear (straight-line) mechanical motion. Description It typically consists of: Flexible diaphragm – separates the pressure chamber from the mechanical side. Actuator housing – contains and supports the diaphragm. Spring or return mechanism – returns the actuator to its normal position when pressure is removed. Stem/rod – transfers the diaphragm’s movement to the driven equipment. Working principle When compressed air or another fluid is introduced into the actuator chamber, pressure acts on the diaphragm and causes it to move linearly. This movement is transferred through the stem to operate a valve, damper, or other mechanism. When the pressure is reduced, a spring or opposing pressure returns the actuator. Applications Linear diaphragm actuators are commonly used for: Control valves Process automation Flow and pressure control HVAC dampers Chemical and industrial processing equipment Advantages: simple construction, reliable operation, good positioning capability, and relatively low maintenance.
